parameters.query: SELECT steele_dl.build_request($1) AS request, steele_wr.setting('draft_service_url', '') AS url, steele_wr.setting('delivery_enabled', '0') AS enabled
WITH s AS (INSERT INTO steele_fake.scenarios SELECT $1, $2 WHERE $3::boolean ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO UPDATE SET scenario = excluded.scenario RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) AS scenario_set FROM s
SELECT CASE WHEN $11::boolean THEN steele_dl.record($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9::jsonb, $10) END AS result

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $json.record ? [$json.requestId, $json.articleId, $json.target, $json.payloadSha256, $json.status, $json.draftId, $json.receiptId, JSON.stringify($json.readback), JSON.stringify($json.history), $json.error, true] : ['', '', 'fake', '', '', null, null, null, '[]', null, false] }}

meta.description: Delivers one saved article to the shared draft service (or its test double): request ID exp-911:n8n:<attempt>, the immutable article and its pinned source; at most 3 tries, reconciliation before any re-create, and strict readback (unpublished, no email) before success.
